annotations.title: Why a TikTok ad was rejected

description: TikTok’s own review verdict for up to 100 ads: approved everywhere (ALL_AVAILABLE), approved for only some of its targeting (PART_AVAILABLE — with the placements, locations, ages or operating systems it is barred from), or rejected (UNAVAILABLE) — with TikTok’s REASONS and its SUGGESTED FIX per piece of content. Use it whenever an ad is not running or the user asks why it was rejected; fix it with update_tiktok_ads_ad. list_tiktok_ads_campaigns(includeReview:true) attaches the same verdict to every ad. Read-only, free.
